Messages.Author: XZealot
Messages.Body:
Antonio d'Erlette
Clan: Tremere antitribu (group 4)
Capacity: 5
Disciplines: THA dom for pot
Sabbat: While Antonio is ready, you may spend four transfers to search
your hand or library (shuffle afterward) for a mage ally Antonio could
play. Put that ally in play with life equal to his starting amount (pay
cost as normal).

Charisma
Type: Master
Unique master.
Put this card on a ready vampire. This vampire's recruit ally actions
cost 1 less blood or pool (but never less than 0 blood or pool).

If I have Charisma on Antioio d'Erlette and use his special to put an
mage ally in play, is the cost reduced by 1 as per Charisma's text?

Comments Welcome,
Norman S. Brown, Jr
XZealot
Archon of the Swamp

Messages.Author: oriang...@aliceadsl.fr
Messages.Body:
Nope, it's not a recruit action but "put that ally in play"
